title: Lab finds unknown chemical burning in soil and tree samples

tellings.quote: took them to the lab and some months later he said that the lab results indicated that the burning of the soil in the tree was caused by chemical products and that they were unknown.

plain: Soil and a tree scorched at the spot near Varginha, Brazil, where some people say an unknown craft came down in 1996, were burned by chemicals that a laboratory could not identify. That is what a surgeon named Carlos de Souza tells Michels, passing on what a woman named Claudia Kovu told him. According to her, the samples went to a lab along with Super Eight film footage, and some months later the results said the burning 'was caused by chemical products and that they were unknown', which, if true, would point to something more than an ordinary fire.
